structure: Michigan K-12 Social Studies Standards (2019), Attachment B. Front matter (goals, C3 framework, GLCE coding, using the GLCE, Public Act 170) then three band overviews (K-2, 3-5, 6-8), each with an overview chart, an Arc of Inquiry (C3 Dimensions 1-4, band-specific) and Process and Skills Standards P1-P4 (K-2, 3-5, 6-8, HS), followed by per-grade content expectations. Grades K-4 are organized by discipline (History, Geography, Civics and Government, Economics, Public Discourse/Civic Participation); codes are grade - letter+standard.0.expectation (e.g. K - G1.0.2, 4 - C5.0.3) with the code and text in two x-position columns (x~58 code, x~144 text) and 'Examples may include but are not limited to:' lines under expectations. Grades 5 and 8 (Integrated U.S. History) are organized by USHG era (5 - U1.1.1; 8 - U4.2.1; grade 8 also has F1 foundations) and grade 6 (World Geography, 6 - G1.1.1) and grade 7 (World History and Geography, 7 - H1.1.1, 7 - W3.1.1) by strand/era with the same expectation layout. Each grade ends with a Public Discourse, Decision Making, and Civic Participation (P3, P4) block. Each grade section starts with a title ('SOCIAL STUDIES CONTENT EXPECTATIONS: GRADE X'), discipline headings, 'Individually and collaboratively, students will engage in planned inquiries...' discipline statements, standard-category headings with strand statements, then coded expectations. Sample compelling and supporting question tables sit in the band overviews. High school is four courses, each with its own Arc of Inquiry and Process and Skills copy preceding it: World History and Geography (F1 foundations, Eras 4-7 expectations coded 4.1.1-7.2.6 as 'x.y.z Title - text', and Contemporary Global Issues CG1-CG4), United States History and Geography (F1, Eras 6-9, 6.1.1-9.3.1), Civics (C - 1.1.1 to C - 6.4.4 in the same two-column layout, with compelling questions and a Democratic Values chart as support) and Economics (E1-E4, 1.1.1-4.1.6). Back matter: writers/reviewers lists and State Board of Education/MDE staff.

The 'Arc of Inquiry' and 'Process and Skills Standards: High School' pages occur four times (u2392-u2439 before the overview chart; u2638-u2685; u2971-u3018; u3394-u3441). WHG therefore has only the shared copy; the placement (copy precedes its course vs. follows the previous course) is inferred from page order and the TOC.
